evals.expected_output: Uses Semantic Scholar (optionally OpenAlex/OpenCitations/Europe PMC) with the DOI: prefix, reads the total citation count first, paginates deterministically and reconciles retrieved vs. total. evals.prompt: I'm writing the methods for a paper on SARS-CoV-2 spike mutations and need the open-access full text of PMID 34567890 so I can check which variants they sequenced. evals.expected_output: Explains that PMC eFetch returns a well-formed article without <body> when the publisher forbids redistribution (a 200 that is not a success). evals.prompt: Our lab is putting together a table of everything our collaborators at the University of Tartu have deposited as datasets or software, plus a stable ID for the institution so we can link their works. Can you track that down?
evals.expected_output: Resolves the affiliation string to a ROR ID via ROR affiliation matching and verifies the match, then searches Zenodo (and optionally Figshare/BioStudies) for deposited records, and uses OpenAlex for the institution's works if needed. Notes Zenodo concept vs. version IDs, Figshare search_for being ignored, and reports queries and counts with provenance.

evals.prompt: Here's my references.bib with 80 entries. Clean it up, dedupe, and fix the formatting so it compiles in LaTeX without warnings.
evals.expected_output: Should not use paper-lookup; this is BibTeX formatting, deduplication and validation, which belongs to citation-management.

evals.prompt: Run a full PRISMA-style systematic review on mindfulness interventions for adolescent anxiety, screen the studies, extract data and write up the synthesis as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Should not use paper-lookup as the main skill; this is an end-to-end systematic review with screening, synthesis and a PRISMA diagram, which belongs to literature-review.
